svg.title: The Assay: Oscilloscope trace
svg.desc: The Assay (1D): an oscilloscope shows the sample's spectrum as a phosphor-green trace on a graticule, with a fading ghost of the run before a reagent suppressed one peak. A band filter isolates 500 to 600 nm, and the cursor sits on a peak reading 512.4 nm, inside the two-nanometre precision. Beside the screen, three of five candidate compositions are struck out and three of six units of sample mass are spent.
